lines.trans: Yes, the office is finally empty.
Look at all these empty chairs.
It is strange without all this noise.
I will never forget this adventure.
Are you ready to leave now?
Yes, let us take our coats.
Oh yes, I was going to forget.

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: aller + infinitive: tu vas l'agacer = you're going to annoy her
ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?
with numbers: huit ans, vingt ans

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: avoir peur = to be afraid, avoir raison = to be right, avoir 40 ans = to be 40
elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.text: Il y a beaucoup de bruit.
Ce n'est pas facile d'apprendre un texte avec tout ce bruit.
examples.trans: It's not easy to learn lines with all this noise.

meanings.note: faire du bruit = to make noise

examples.trans: Are you going to your desk?

examples.text: Je sais que tu mens. J'ai vu Mathias poser cette enveloppe sur ton bureau.
examples.trans: I know you're lying. I saw Mathias put that envelope on your desk.

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.trans: Look at all these empty chairs.

examples.text: J'ai perdu un ami très cher.
examples.trans: I've lost a very dear friend.

examples.text: Andréa, Samuel est mort. J'ai perdu un ami très cher.
examples.trans: Andréa, Samuel is dead. I've lost a very dear friend.

meanings.note: before the noun: un ami très cher
after the noun or after être

examples.text: Le bureau est au bout du couloir.
examples.trans: The office is at the end of the corridor.

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.note: je n'ai pas de temps; also before a plural adjective: de mauvaises nouvelles

examples.text: Pourquoi te donner dix pour cent si tu ne me défends pas?
examples.trans: Why give you ten percent if you don't stand up for me?

meanings.note: pronounced dis alone, di before a consonant, diz before a vowel

examples.text: On a toujours voulu jouer ensemble.
examples.trans: We've always wanted to act together.

meanings.en: as a noun: the whole, a set

examples.text: Tu as fait quelque chose de formidable.
Super, Mathias! Tu as fait quelque chose de formidable. Bravo!
examples.trans: Great, Mathias! You did something wonderful. Well done!

meanings.note: Adjective of capability/quality formed with '-able'/'-ible' (from Latin '-abilis'/'-ibilis').

examples.text: Nous avons presque perdu une grande star!
examples.trans: We almost lost a big star!

meanings.note: before the noun: une grande actrice = a great actress

examples.text: Je ne suis jamais en retard.
Gabriel! Je suis à mon cours d'équitation.
examples.trans: Gabriel! I'm at my horse-riding lesson.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Il y a de la lumière.
Oui. Elle attrape bien la lumière.
examples.trans: Yes. She catches the light well.

examples.text: Très bien. Tu peux commencer maintenant?
examples.trans: Very good. Can you start now?

examples.text: Voici ton manteau chaud pour sortir.
examples.trans: Here is your warm coat to go outside.

examples.text: Non merci, pas le manteau aujourd'hui.
examples.trans: No thank you, not the coat today.

examples.text: Voici ton manteau chaud pour sortir, Jean.
examples.trans: Here is your warm coat to go outside, Jean.

examples.text: C'est comme un rêve pour moi.
examples.trans: It's like a dream for me.

examples.text: Je joue en ce moment dans un spectacle à la Porte des Lilas.
examples.trans: I'm in a show at the moment, at the Porte des Lilas.

meanings.note: Masculine action/result noun formed with the Romance suffix '-ment' (from Latin '-mentum'). Standard masculine noun meaning 'moment, while'.

meanings.en: en ce moment = at the moment, currently

examples.trans: You know a lot of people.

meanings.note: tout le monde = everyone; il y a du monde = it's crowded
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never

examples.text: Oh non! Je suis en retard.

meanings.note: at the end of a sentence: super, non?
tag at the end of a question

examples.text: Samuel a oublié de vous apprendre la ténacité.
examples.trans: Samuel forgot to teach you tenacity.

meanings.note: First-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are'), the most productive verb class in French. Core French verb meaning 'to forget'.

meanings.en: oublier de + infinitive = to forget to

examples.text: Oui, oui. J'ai juste besoin d'un petit cours.
examples.trans: Yes, yes. I just need a little lesson.

meanings.note: no object: je pars = I'm leaving
partir en vacances = to go on holiday
pronounced plys when it means 'more' at the end
prends de la gelée royale = take some royal jelly

examples.text: Ils sont prêts à en discuter.
examples.trans: They're ready to talk about it.

examples.text: Sans rendez-vous? Je ne promets rien.
examples.trans: Without an appointment? I'm not promising anything.

examples.text: C'est un film très sombre. J'ai besoin d'optimisme.
examples.trans: It's a very dark film. I need optimism.

meanings.note: of a story or a film

examples.text: Oui, trois cent mille. Je parle de ses vingt ans de carrière.
examples.trans: Yes, three hundred thousand. I'm talking about his twenty years of career.

meanings.note: agrees with the thing owned, not the owner

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age

examples.text: Votre regard est vide, il ne se passe rien.
examples.trans: Your look is blank, nothing is happening.

examples.text: Cette séquence est maintenant vide de substance.
examples.trans: This sequence is now empty of substance.

examples.text: J'ai vécu ici quand j'étais étudiante.
examples.trans: I lived here when I was a student.

meanings.note: vivre à Paris = to live in Paris

examples.text: Et voilà la salle de presse. On appelle ça la boutique.
examples.trans: And here's the press room. We call it the shop.

voilà.gloss: there is; here's; there you go

meanings.note: place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les

éteindre.gloss: to extinguish, put out, go extinct

meanings.en: to extinguish, switch off; go extinct (s'éteindre)
meanings.note: s'éteindre = to die out, become extinct

examples.trans: Humanity is going to become extinct.

examples.text: Si ça continue, l'humanité va s'éteindre!
examples.trans: If this continues, humanity will go extinct!
